append.detail: 2026-11-09 retirement scan: the original patch (f6dd66168) naming the eight modules is not in the repo, so I scanned components/ and lib/ for navigation, menu, rail, dock, header, footer and tab modules that nothing imports. One is truly dead: components/frequency/members/route-tabs.tsx (33 lines, no importer, test or probe); it is deleted here. The other candidates are live (lib/nav/prefetch-fuse.ts is installed from instrumentation-client.ts, lib/nav/marker-cookie and the two rewrite modules from proxy.ts, marketing-header/footer from app/page.tsx), or are guard targets (admin-rail-drawer-column, header-offset). Seven of the eight retirements are still unidentified, so the row stays OPEN. 2026-11-09 (owner approved each pin rewrite by name): deleted components/spaces/dashboard/space-dashboard.tsx, components/spaces/spaces-toolbar.tsx, components/admin/admin-rail-drawer-column.tsx and lib/nav/my-frequency-rows.ts, with their pins edited (series-browse-wiring and space-events-gate entries, the check-vocab entry, the active-member-shell-contracts viewport list, header-offset.test consumers; nav-coverage.test keeps the four My Frequency destinations as data so the coverage check is unchanged). lib/layout/header-offset.ts was approved for deletion but kept: it is the LIVE-492 detector the viewport probe and its test run, not an unused module. Six retirements in all with route-tabs; the row's other two are still unidentified.
